CONFIRM C0031 — Valid. The `^\s*` + `re.escape(gate)` pattern at line 114 does not consume markdown bold markers (`**`). A gate line like `**S_min**: PASS` fails to match because `re.escape("S_min")` produces `S_min`, which cannot match `**S_min**` at the position after `^\s*`. The proposed fix (inserting optional `\*{0,2}` around the gate pattern) is the right shape.

FIND: The C0030 fix (word-boundary enforcement on status patterns) is incomplete. On line 107, the σ_measured status pattern was corrected to `NA(?![A-Za-z])`, but neither `PASS` nor `FAIL` in either status pattern received word-boundary enforcement. The non-σ_measured pattern remains `r"(PASS|FAIL)"` and the σ_measured pattern is `r"(PASS|FAIL|N/A|NA(?![A-Za-z]))"`. A gate line containing a word that starts with PASS or FAIL (e.g. `S_min: PASSING — evidence below` or `d_tool: FAILURE detected`) would match the substring `PASS` or `FAIL`, producing a false verdict.

Location: `_feedback_slice.py`, line 107.

Evidence: the regex `r"^\s*S_min\s*[:\-=]?\s*(PASS|FAIL)"` applied to the string `"  S_min: PASSING – see below"` matches, capturing `"PASS"` as group(1). The gate is classified as PASS when the model did not intend a clean pass verdict.

FOLLOW: Downstream, a false PASS removes the gate from the `failed` list. The finding is then treated as having passed that admissibility gate. The §17 feedback channel does not flag the gate, so the model receives no corrective signal. The error is silent — the finding enters the registry with inflated admissibility status. This affects any gate line where PASS/FAIL appears as a prefix of a longer word.

ANALYSE: SOFT constraint. The expected format per the §15 prompt template is `gate: PASS (reason)` or `gate: FAIL (reason)`, making the false-positive scenario unlikely under normal model behaviour. However, models occasionally produce natural-language status descriptions rather than bare PASS/FAIL tokens. The risk is real but low-frequency. CONFIRMED — the pattern demonstrably matches prefix substrings; whether it triggers depends on model output formatting.
